import json, hashlib, re
from pathlib import Path
def read(p):
    return json.loads(Path(p).read_text())
def sha(p):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
scenario_path, packet_path, table_path, control_path, output = __import__('sys').argv[1:]
s, p, t, c = map(read, [scenario_path, packet_path, table_path, control_path])
assert sha(packet_path) == s['reply_packet_sha256']
assert sha(table_path) == p['rehearsal_sha256']
assert len(t['checks']) == 5 and all(x['passed'] for x in t['checks'])
assert all(set(d) == {'en','fr'} and all(isinstance(v,str) and v.strip() for v in d.values()) for d in t['operator_reply_drafts'].values())
runs = c['runs']
assert [r['exit_code'] for r in runs] == [0,1]
assert [json.loads(r['stdout']) for r in runs] == [{'conflicting_families':{}},{'conflicting_families':{'linen-shirt':['G1','G2']}}]
assert len(s['scenarios']) == 2
match = re.fullmatch(r'EN\n(.+)\n\nFR\n(.+)',p['replies']['commission'],re.S)
assert match and all(x.strip() for x in match.groups())
intake = {'en':'Paste up to 20 CSV rows including the header as plain text. Use synthetic or anonymized data and exclude attachments and confidential information.', 'fr':'Collez en texte brut jusqu’à 20 lignes de CSV, en-tête compris. Utilisez des données fictives ou anonymisées et excluez les pièces jointes et les renseignements confidentiels.'}
replies = []
for item in s['scenarios']:
    replies.append({'case':item['case'], **{lang:base+'\n\n'+intake[lang]+'\n\n'+item['operator_reply_insert_'+lang] for lang,base in zip(('en','fr'),match.groups())}})
result={'all_pass':True,'usage':s['scope'],'price_handling':s['price_handling'],'item_4_handling':s['item_4_handling'],'inputs':{path:sha(path) for path in [scenario_path,packet_path,table_path,control_path]},'observed_controls':[{'exit_code': r['exit_code'], 'output':json.loads(r['stdout'])} for r in runs],'replies':replies}
Path(output).write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'verified':result['all_pass'],'scenario_count':len(replies),'sha256':sha(output)}))
